name: Plytix PIM
description: Plytix PIM API for product information: product search, products and variants, linked assets, categories and related products, the asset library, attributes, relationships and product families. API key and API password.
instructions:
## Plytix PIM
This connector works with the **Plytix PIM API v1** (`https://pim.plytix.com/api/v1`): product search, products and their variants, linked assets, categories and related products, the asset library (search, add from URL), product attributes, categories, relationship types and product families.

**Setup (about 3 minutes, account owner or admin)**
1. In Plytix open **Account Administration, API** (https://accounts.plytix.com) and click **Add API key**. Choose the role the key acts with (an editor role is enough for these tools; viewer for read-only use).
2. Copy the **API key** into `PLYTIX_API_KEY` and the **API password** into `PLYTIX_API_PASSWORD`. The password is shown only once.

The connector posts both to `https://auth.plytix.com/auth/api/get-token` for an access token, which lasts 15 minutes, and asks for a new one shortly before it runs out. Plytix also offers its own MCP server (`https://pim.plytix.com/mcp`, OAuth sign-in) when your account manager has enabled it; this connector works with plain API keys.

**Where to start**: `plytix_list_product_filters` shows the searchable fields and the keys of your custom attributes. Then `plytix_search_products` (always pass attributes, otherwise only id and sku come back) and `plytix_get_product` for everything about one product.

**Products**: `plytix_search_products`, `plytix_list_product_filters`, `plytix_get_product`, `plytix_create_product`, `plytix_update_product`, `plytix_assign_product_family`. `plytix_delete_product` is installed switched off.

**Variants**: `plytix_list_product_variants`, `plytix_add_product_variant` (new product as a variant), `plytix_link_variant` (existing product as a variant). Variants inherit parent attributes unless a value is overwritten on the variant.

**Assets, categories, related products**: `plytix_list_product_assets`, `plytix_link_product_asset`, `plytix_unlink_product_asset`, `plytix_list_product_categories`, `plytix_link_product_category`, `plytix_unlink_product_category`, `plytix_add_related_products`, `plytix_remove_related_products`. Unlinking never deletes the asset, category or related product.

**Library and data model**: `plytix_search_assets`, `plytix_get_asset`, `plytix_create_asset_from_url`, `plytix_search_attributes`, `plytix_get_attribute`, `plytix_search_categories`, `plytix_search_relationships`, `plytix_search_product_families`, `plytix_list_family_attributes`.

**Search**: filters are a list of AND groups combined with OR: `[[{"field":"status","operator":"eq","value":"Completed"}],[{"field":"sku","operator":"like","value":"MUG"}]]` finds completed products OR products whose SKU contains MUG. Custom attributes are addressed as `attributes.` plus their label (for example `attributes.in_stock`), in filters and in the attributes list. At most 50 attributes per request.

**Field notes**: ids are 24-character hex strings. status is Draft or Completed. product_type is single, parent, variant (and sub-variant on some plans). Dates are ISO 8601 in UTC. Every answer is wrapped in `data` (a list, also for one record); errors carry `error.msg` and `error.errors` with the field.

**Paging and limits**: page from 1 and page_size up to 100; the answer's `pagination.total_count` gives the total. Sorting more than 10,000 results answers 428: narrow the filter. Plytix limits requests per 10 seconds and per hour depending on the plan (429 when exceeded); ask your account manager for your numbers and avoid loops over thousands of products.

PLYTIX_API_KEY.label: API key
PLYTIX_API_KEY.help: Account Administration, API (accounts.plytix.com): the API key. Only account owners and admins can create keys.
PLYTIX_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the API key without spaces.

PLYTIX_API_PASSWORD.label: API password
PLYTIX_API_PASSWORD.help: Shown once when the API key is created. Create a new key if it was lost.
PLYTIX_API_PASSWORD.patternMessage: Paste the API password without spaces.

401.hint: Plytix refused the API key and password ("Bad api_key or api_password"). Copy both again from Account Administration, API, or create a new key.

verifyHints.403: The API key's role may not do this. Give the key a role with edit rights in Account Administration, API.
verifyHints.404: No product, asset or other record with that id.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Plytix limits requests per 10 seconds and per hour by plan. Wait a little and try again.

prerequisites: A Plytix PIM account and an owner or admin who can create an API key under Account Administration, API. About 3 minutes.

tools.name: plytix_search_products
tools.description: Search products with filters: id and sku always, plus the attributes you list (system ones such as label, status, gtin, created, modified, categories, assets, thumbnail, product_level, and custom ones as `attributes.LABEL`). Returns data and pagination with total_count. Up to 100 per page and 50 attributes per request.

filters.description: Filter groups: a list of lists of conditions, each with field, operator and value. Conditions inside one inner list are combined with AND, the inner lists with OR. Operators: eq, !eq, like, in, !in, gt, gte, lt, lte, exists, !exists, text_search. Example: `[[{"field":"sku","operator":"like","value":"MUG"}]]`. Leave it out for everything.

attributes.description: Fields to return besides id and sku, for example `["label","status","modified","attributes.price"]`. Custom attributes take the prefix `attributes.` and their label; plytix_list_product_filters lists the keys.

relationship_filters.description: Filters on related products, in the same shape as filters with relationship fields.

order.description: Sort field; prefix with - for descending, for example `-modified`.

tools.name: plytix_list_product_filters
tools.description: List the fields products can be searched and returned by: system attributes and every custom attribute with its key (`attributes.LABEL`), type and allowed operators. Call it before building a search.

tools.name: plytix_get_product
tools.description: Get one product: id, sku, label, status (Draft or Completed), gtin, custom attributes, categories, assets, thumbnail, product_family_id, product_type (single, parent, variant), _parent_id, num_variations, relationships with related products, created and modified.

all_attributes.description: true includes empty attributes as null.

tools.name: plytix_create_product
tools.description: Create a product. Only sku is required; custom attribute values go under attributes by label. Existing assets and categories can be linked by id. New attributes, categories or assets are not created here. Answers 201 with the product.

sku.description: Product SKU, unique in the account.

attributes.description: Custom attribute values by label, for example `{"stock":123,"color":["Blue"]}`.

tools.name: plytix_update_product
tools.description: Change a product (only the fields sent): label, status and custom attribute values by label. Send null to empty an attribute. Answers with the updated product.

attributes.description: Custom attribute values to set by label, for example `{"price":19.9,"description":"..."}`.

tools.name: plytix_delete_product
tools.description: Delete a product permanently, with its links to assets, categories and relationships. Cannot be undone. Installed switched off.

product_id.description: Product to delete id (24 hex characters).

tools.name: plytix_assign_product_family
tools.description: Assign a product family to a product, which decides the attributes it shows. Changing the family can hide values of attributes the new family does not have.

tools.name: plytix_list_product_variants
tools.description: List the variants of a parent product: id, sku, label, status, attributes, overwritten_attributes, product_family_model_id, created and modified.

tools.name: plytix_add_product_variant
tools.description: Create a new product as a variant of a parent product, with sku, label and optional attribute values (a value set here overrides the inherited one). Turning a single product into a parent can lose data on it.

attributes.description: Attribute values of the variant by label.

tools.name: plytix_link_variant
tools.description: Make an existing product a variant of another product (the parent). The variant then inherits the parent attributes.

variant_id.description: Product that becomes the variant id (24 hex characters).

tools.name: plytix_list_product_assets
tools.description: List the assets linked to a product: id, filename, url, thumbnail, content_type and the attribute they are linked to.

tools.name: plytix_link_product_asset
tools.description: Link an existing asset to a product, in the assets list or in a media attribute such as thumbnail. At most 300 assets per product.

attribute_label.description: Where to link it: assets (default list), thumbnail, or the label of a media or media gallery attribute.

tools.name: plytix_unlink_product_asset
tools.description: Remove the link between an asset and a product. The asset itself stays in the account.

tools.name: plytix_list_product_categories
tools.description: List the product categories a product belongs to: id, name, path and parents_ids.

tools.name: plytix_link_product_category
tools.description: Put a product into an existing product category (find the id with plytix_search_categories).

tools.name: plytix_unlink_product_category
tools.description: Take a product out of a product category. The category and its other products stay.

tools.name: plytix_add_related_products
tools.description: Add products to a relationship of a product (for example accessories or spare parts), each with a quantity. A product already related gets its quantity updated. Answers with the relationship and its related products.

tools.name: plytix_remove_related_products
tools.description: Remove products from a relationship of a product. The products themselves stay. Answers 204.

tools.name: plytix_search_assets
tools.description: Search assets (images and files) with filters: id plus the fields you list, such as filename, url, thumbnail, content_type, file_type, file_size, extension, categories, n_products, created and modified. Up to 100 per page.

filters.description: Filter groups: a list of lists of conditions, each with field, operator and value. Conditions inside one inner list are combined with AND, the inner lists with OR. Operators: eq, !eq, like, in, !in, gt, gte, lt, lte, exists, !exists, text_search. Example: `[[{"field":"sku","operator":"like","value":"MUG"}]]`. Leave it out for everything.

order.description: Sort field; prefix with - for descending, for example `-modified`.

tools.name: plytix_get_asset
tools.description: Get one asset: filename, url, thumbnail, content_type, file_type, file_size, extension, categories, n_products, status, created and modified.

tools.name: plytix_create_asset_from_url
tools.description: Add an asset by giving a public URL; Plytix downloads the file. Formats are not converted, so keep the filename extension matching the file. Answers 201 with the asset (409 if it already exists).

filename.description: File name to store; defaults to the name in the URL.

tools.name: plytix_search_attributes
tools.description: Search product attributes: id plus the fields you list, such as name, label, type_class (text, number, dropdown, multiselect, media and others), options, groups, description, created and modified.

filters.description: Filter groups: a list of lists of conditions, each with field, operator and value. Conditions inside one inner list are combined with AND, the inner lists with OR. Operators: eq, !eq, like, in, !in, gt, gte, lt, lte, exists, !exists, text_search. Example: `[[{"field":"sku","operator":"like","value":"MUG"}]]`. Leave it out for everything.

order.description: Sort field; prefix with - for descending, for example `-modified`.

tools.name: plytix_get_attribute
tools.description: Get one product attribute: name, label, type_class, options (for dropdown and multiselect), groups and description.

tools.name: plytix_search_categories
tools.description: Search product categories: id plus the fields you list: name, path, parents_ids, n_children and order.

filters.description: Filter groups: a list of lists of conditions, each with field, operator and value. Conditions inside one inner list are combined with AND, the inner lists with OR. Operators: eq, !eq, like, in, !in, gt, gte, lt, lte, exists, !exists, text_search. Example: `[[{"field":"sku","operator":"like","value":"MUG"}]]`. Leave it out for everything.

order.description: Sort field; prefix with - for descending, for example `-modified`.

tools.name: plytix_search_relationships
tools.description: Search relationship types (how products relate, for example accessories): id plus the fields you list, such as name, label, symmetrical and modified.

filters.description: Filter groups: a list of lists of conditions, each with field, operator and value. Conditions inside one inner list are combined with AND, the inner lists with OR. Operators: eq, !eq, like, in, !in, gt, gte, lt, lte, exists, !exists, text_search. Example: `[[{"field":"sku","operator":"like","value":"MUG"}]]`. Leave it out for everything.

order.description: Sort field; prefix with - for descending, for example `-modified`.

tools.name: plytix_search_product_families
tools.description: Search product families: id plus the fields you list, such as name, parent_attributes_count and modified.

filters.description: Filter groups: a list of lists of conditions, each with field, operator and value. Conditions inside one inner list are combined with AND, the inner lists with OR. Operators: eq, !eq, like, in, !in, gt, gte, lt, lte, exists, !exists, text_search. Example: `[[{"field":"sku","operator":"like","value":"MUG"}]]`. Leave it out for everything.

order.description: Sort field; prefix with - for descending, for example `-modified`.

tools.name: plytix_list_family_attributes
tools.description: List the attributes linked to a product family, with their attribute level (parent or variant).
